headline: Former dairy farm to become climate-resilient nature reserve
summary: Avon Wildlife Trust will transform the 44-acre site near Bristol into a haven for birds, bats and newts, funded by a major bequest.
script: A former dairy farm in southwest England will become a climate-resilient nature reserve. Avon Wildlife Trust plans to turn the forty-four acre site into a haven for birds, bats and newts, funded by a major bequest.
imageAlt: Aerial view of the former dairy farm with fields, barns and a pond.
imageAltTwo: An Avon Wildlife Trust staff member stands in a field at the farm site.
